title: Catalog
description: The whole fault catalog as one document: the machine, its signal registry, its controller messages, the symptom conditions, the causes, the maintenance plan and the controller parameters. The manual build writes it to tools/eval/fixtures/catalog.json, init ingests it and the evaluation harness scores against it. It is not an MQTT message and carries no envelope, but it repeats its schema id so a reader can reject an unknown major.

catalog_signal.title: Catalog signal
catalog_signal.description: One entry of the signal registry, in register order.

panel_label.description: How the panel labels the tag.

metropt_column.description: The replay source column, or null for a synthesised tag.

group.description: Which block of the register slot the tag occupies.

unit.description: SI unit, or bool for a digital tag.

range.description: Lowest and highest value the tag can take.

normal_band.description: What normal looks like per machine state, keyed by state name: a two-number interval for an analog tag, the expected value for a digital one. Left free on purpose, because the manual states a digital band as a level and not as an interval.

section.description: Manual section the tag is listed in.

catalog_alarm.title: Catalog alarm
catalog_alarm.description: One controller message. bit is the alarm-bit position the simulator sets, or null for a message the simulator never evaluates.

title.description: The message as the panel shows it.

signal.description: The tag or derived quantity the trigger watches.

direction.description: Which side of the threshold raises the message.

threshold.description: The value the trigger compares against, or null when the trigger is not a threshold.

delay_s.description: How long the condition must hold, or null when it fires at once.

text.description: What the manual says about the message.

section.description: Manual section the message is listed in.

catalog_condition.title: Catalog condition
catalog_condition.description: One symptom of the fault-finding tables, with the causes that explain it.

symptom.description: What the operator sees, in one sentence.

symptoms.description: Further wordings of the same symptom, used to build retrieval queries.

causes.description: The causes listed under the condition, most likely first.

pages.description: Where the condition appears in each built variant of the manual.

catalog_maintenance.title: Catalog maintenance task
catalog_maintenance.description: One task of the maintenance plan.

interval.description: How often the task is due.

catalog_parameter.title: Catalog parameter
catalog_parameter.description: One controller setting a technician can change.

param_no.description: The number on the controller panel.

generated_from.description: What the document was built from. Stays open: the build adds fields such as the variant it exported.

machine.description: The fictional machine this catalog describes.

signals.description: The signal registry, in register order.

alarms.description: Every controller message, in code order.

conditions.description: The symptoms of the fault-finding tables.

causes.description: Every cause, each one a catalog entry.
